performance.driver: Operating income Operating income increased by $819,000, or 30.7%, to $3,489,000, or 18.7% of net revenues, for the three months ended September 30, 2026, compared to the same period in the prior year. The increase was primarily due to an increase in revenue and gross profit.

Total revenue decreased by $6.2 or 2.8% and increased by $11.4 or 1.7% for the three and nine month periods ended October 3, 2026 compared to the three and nine month periods ended September 27, 2025. The decrease in the three month period was primarily attributable to the continuation of organic volume declines associated with uncertainty in the macroeconomic environment, sustained elevated interest rates, along with lower housing churn which was not fully offset by inorganic revenues of $10.7 from the Kiwi II acquisition.

Revenue Three months ended Revenue for the three months ended October 3, 2026 was $727 million, an increase of $24 million, or 3.4%, compared to the same period in 2025. The increase was primarily due to $29 million from favorable price, partially offset by $4 million of unfavorable impacts from foreign currency exchange rates and $2 million from lower sales volume.

Revenue for the nine months ended October 4, 2026 was $1,100.1 million, as compared to $1,049.1 million for the nine months ended September 28, 2025, an increase of $51.0 million, or 5%. The increase in our Life Sciences segment revenue during the nine months ended October 4, 2026 was driven by an increase of $38.1 million in Life Sciences Solutions revenue and an increase of $12.9 million in Software revenue.

Revenue The Company’s revenue increased 121% in the third quarter of 2026, as compared to the third quarter of 2025 and 110% for the first nine months of 2026 as compared to the first nine months of 2025, primarily driven by $896 million and $2.2 billion of revenue contributed by the BDS Business for the third quarter and since the Closing Date for the first nine months of 2026, respectively.
